sloka: किं तु तस्य बलज्ञोऽहं दुर्भ्रातुर्बलशालिनः ।अप्रत्यक्षं तु मे वीर्यं समरे तव राघव ॥४-११-७९॥।।
transliteration: kiṁ tu tasya balajño'haṁ durbhrāturbalaśālinaḥ ।apratyakṣaṁ tu me vīryaṁ samare tava rāghava ॥4-11-79॥।।

translations.english: 'What to do? I know the strength of my mighty bad brother. But so far I have not seen your power in a battle.
